sources.executableRule: selected HRCM hierarchy node low word > 0x7000 ? nodeType - 0x7001 : 0

evidenceBoundary: Each mapping is decoded from the root hierarchy node of the exact CHRM bytes extracted from HUMANS.AFS. The asset SHA-256 must match the archive provenance manifest. Retained live-RAM observations are an independent cross-check and must agree; they are not used to choose or infer a family.
